explanation: The value is nonzero only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a choice of a1 that reached S1 by a common transition; it is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 right after an a2 choice or after any rare transition. It builds up over consecutive a1-to-S1 common trials (about 3, then 6, 7, 8, 9 from the first to the fourth), reaches 10 when that previous a1 common trial went unrewarded (8 or 9 if the run is short), and tops out around 6-7 early in the episode (before trial 30) but 9-10 in the middle (trials 45-60).
